HistorySection.title: Our History
HistorySection.description: A journey of constant evolution, adapting to the technological and social challenges of each era.
HistorySection.lpradDesc: Linked to PPGEE/UFPA, it constituted the first state-of-the-art laboratory in telecommunications network technologies in the Amazon region. It carried out activities related to various network technologies (backbone, access, and "last mile" - wired and wireless) from an optical network planning, aiming at evaluating and optimizing the performance of these networks.
HistorySection.ltsDesc: Also linked to the Applied Computing concentration area of PPGEE/UFPA, it had an interdisciplinary and multi-institutional role, bringing together researchers and institutions of diverse profiles. It was based on the use of mathematical and computational models to solve real-world problems in areas such as energy, public health, social security, environment, education, and digital inclusion.

HistorySection.labcityDesc: The consolidation of our journey, uniting the legacy of high performance and social impact to create smarter, more sustainable, and human cities in the Amazon.

SobrePage.title: What is LabCity?
SobrePage.description: We are an innovation laboratory at the Federal University of Pará (UFPA) dedicated to transforming cities through technology.
SobrePage.journey1Desc: LabCity was founded with the clear mission of transforming the urban reality of the Amazon through applied technology.
SobrePage.journey2Desc: Since our conception at UFPA, we have expanded our operations by integrating Artificial Intelligence, IoT, and strategic partnerships for efficient public management.
SobrePage.techDesc: We work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things (IoT), and Data Science to create smart and responsive urban systems.
SobrePage.regionalDesc: Our research is not just theoretical; it is applied to solve real problems in Belém and the Amazon region, such as mobility, sanitation, and environmental monitoring.
SobrePage.talentDesc: More than code, we develop people. LabCity is a hotbed of new researchers, preparing students for the challenges of the global technology market.
SobrePage.socialDesc: We believe that a smart city must be a city for everyone. Our projects aim to democratize access to urban services and promote digital inclusion.
